2609.30027.title: Synthetic Hospital: An Open, Verifiable, Physician-Validated Longitudinal EHR Benchmark
2609.30027.paper_summary: Frontier language models are rarely used in clinical workflows because the realistic, longitudinal benchmarks needed to develop them are scarce. Real electronic health record (EHR) data cannot be openly shared due to privacy, ethics or data use issues and it does not contain verifiable ground truth since the chart records only reflect what clinicians documented. We introduce Synthetic Hospital, an open, fully synthetic, fact-grounded longitudinal EHR benchmark that resolves the open sharing and verifiable ground truth barriers. Built entirely from public medical-education material with no protected health information, it comprises 1,268 longitudinal patients and 5,602 encounters, where every diagnosis, finding, and temporal relation is grounded in standard ontologies (ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT, LOINC) and with a complete provenance chain back to its source medical education material. Synthetic Hospital is served through a simulated hospital record system that mirrors real EHR infrastructure (standard interoperability APIs, role-based access and function-calling interface). In a blinded review, physicians distinguished its records from real patient charts at near-chance rates (53\%). Across 10 frontier and open models, none approaches ceiling: the best model reconstructs a patient's longitudinal problem list with a severity-weighted F1 of 0.73, level with the mean of seven physicians on a matched subset but well below the best of them (0.89), and misses roughly half of clinically relevant findings when summarizing a chart. Overall, these results highlight that Synthetic Hospital is a difficult and realistic test of clinical AI performance.
2609.30027.paper_summary_zh: 前沿語言模型在臨床工作流程中很少被使用，因為開發它們所需的現實長期基準非常稀缺。由於隱私、倫理或數據使用問題，真正的電子健康記錄（EHR）數據無法公開共享，並且它不包含可驗證的真實數據，因為病歷記錄僅反映臨床醫生所記錄的內容。我們介紹了Synthetic Hospital，一個開放的、完全合成的、基於事實的長期EHR基準，解決了公開共享和可驗證真實數據的障礙。它完全由公共醫學教育材料構建，沒有受保護的健康信息，包含1,268名長期患者和5,602次就診，每一個診斷、發現和時間關係都基於標準本體（ICD-10-CM、SNOMED CT、LOINC），並且有完整的來源鏈回到其源醫學教育材料。Synthetic Hospital通過一個模擬的醫院記錄系統提供服務，該系統模仿真實的EHR基礎設施（標準互操作性API、基於角色的訪問和功能調用接口）。在盲評中，醫生以接近隨機的比率（53%）區分其記錄與真實患者病歷。在10個前沿和開放模型中，沒有一個接近上限：最佳模型重建患者的長期問題清單，其嚴重性加權的F1為0.73，與七位醫生在匹配子集上的平均水平相當，但遠低於他們中最好的（0.89），並且在總結病歷時錯過了大約一半的臨床相關發現。總體而言，這些結果突顯了Synthetic Hospital是臨床AI性能的一個困難且現實的測試。
